messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Release v2026.03.21 -> prod paused by preflight: env parity check failed for key `DB_CONN`. staging!=prod. See checks: https://ci.internal/runs/9876

emma: Can someone paste the exact diff?

raj: Staging stores `DB_CONN` as base64 blob (sops-enc then base64). Prod has plain urlencoded DSN. parsing fails in prod-sidecar.

ci-bot: Preflight snippet:
```
staging: DB_CONN=ZGV2OnBhc3N3b3JkQHN0Zy5zZXJ2ZXI6NTQzMg==\nprod: DB_CONN=postgres%3A%2F%2Fdev%3Apass%40prod.db%3A5432%2Fapp%3Fsslmode%3Drequire
```

lucy: Huh, why would staging be base64-ing the SOPS result? config-migration script changed last month.

raj: I think a vault-to-sops migration introduced an extra encode step for tenant-scoped secrets. Only affected services with tenant header normalization.

emma: Impact: if we promote, runtime will feed the base64 into the client and connection strings will break (observed in canary run). Not acceptable.

ops-oncall: Change window ends in 2h. If we hotpatch prod we need an emergency release approval from infra leads.

lucy: Options: 1) rollback to previous pin (v2026.03.20) and backfill secret parity 2) hotpatch transform in init container to detect+decode base64 3) fix secret encoding upstream then promote.

raj: Rollback would be fastest to restore prior behavior. But note some downstream infra metrics expect new pin. Could be messy for clients.

emma: Hotpatch init decode seems low-risk and quick. I can prepare a 10-min canary once raj confirms DB credentials format.

raj: I'll validate exact tenant keys and backfill a tolerant secret for prod (will add plain DSN alias). ETA 35m.

lucy: I'll draft release note addendum: explain paused due to env-parity encoding, include migration steps. Link: https://confluence/internal/releases/v2026.03.21-drift-note

ops-oncall: Approve hotpatch canary if security ok. @emma @raj run the decode locally and add an audit log for secret access.

emma: Running local decode test now. If pass, I'll publish canary and ping infra for eyes.

deploy-bot: Release v2026.03.21 status: PAUSED (reason: DB_CONN encoding mismatch). Assigned: raj -> secret backfill, emma -> canary deploy, lucy -> release notes.

raj: Done prepping alias in prod paramstore, left original as-is. Added env var `DB_CONN_PLAIN` for canary.

emma: Canary up. 5 requests sanity ok. No parse errors. Observability shows no credential leaks. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: Infra eyeballs green. Proceed with limited rollout after monitoring window.

lucy: I'll update release notes and mark the release as resumed once rollout completes.

deploy-bot: Action log: paused->canary->resume pending. final decision will be recorded in release notes.
